name: Sensitive
summary: The Sensitive EA is a high-frequency scalping expert advisor that uses a combination of moving average crossovers and RSI momentum filters to generate rapid entry and exit signals on lower timeframes. It aims to capture small price movements with tight take-profit targets and employs a trailing stop mechanism to lock in gains. The EA is designed for liquid currency pairs and operates primarily on M1-M15 charts.
summary_zh: Sensitive EA是一个高频剥头皮专家顾问，结合均线交叉和RSI动量过滤器在低周期图表上生成快速进出场信号。它旨在通过紧密的止盈目标捕获小幅价格波动，并采用追踪止损机制锁定利润。该EA专为流动性货币对设计，主要在M1至M15周期上运行。
strategy_analysis: Sensitive EA的核心策略是基于快速均线交叉配合RSI动量确认的剥头皮交易系统。入场条件为短期均线上穿或下穿长期均线，同时RSI需处于超买或超卖区间作为过滤确认，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。出场条件包括固定点数止盈、固定止损以及动态追踪止损三重机制，其中追踪止损在盈利达到一定阈值后启动，逐步上移止损位以保护浮盈。仓位管理采用固定手数模式，未集成基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位计算，这限制了资金管理的灵活性。资金管理方面依赖止损距离控制单笔风险，但缺少最大回撤限制和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制，在极端行情下可能面临较大回撤风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of the Sensitive EA is a scalping system based on fast moving average crossovers confirmed by RSI momentum filtering. Entry conditions require the short-period moving average to cross above or below the long-period moving average, while the RSI must be in overbought or oversold zones as a confirmation filter to avoid excessive trades in ranging markets. Exit conditions include a fixed-point take-profit, a fixed stop-loss, and a dynamic trailing stop mechanism that activates once profit exceeds a threshold, progressively moving the stop-loss to protect unrealized gains. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model without integration of dynamic lot calculation based on account equity or volatility, which limits flexibility in money management. Risk management relies on stop-loss distance to control per-trade risk, but lacks maximum drawdown limits and position reduction after consecutive losses, potentially facing significant drawdowns during extreme market conditions.
pros: 多重确认机制（均线交叉+RSI过滤）减少了虚假信号
追踪止损能有效锁定浮动盈利，减少盈利回吐
参数简洁明了，易于理解和调优
剥头皮策略在趋势明确时胜率较高
pros_en: Multi-confirmation mechanism (MA crossover + RSI filter) reduces false signals
Trailing stop effectively locks in floating profits and reduces profit givebacks
Clean and intuitive parameter set, easy to understand and optimize
Scalping strategy achieves higher win rates during clear trending conditions
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险自适应调整
缺少最大回撤保护和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制
剥头皮策略对点差敏感，未内置点差过滤可能导致高成本交易
未做新K线检查，同一根K线可能重复开仓
止损相对止盈较大（风险回报比约2:1），需要较高胜率才能盈利
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, cannot adapt to account risk
No maximum drawdown protection or position reduction after consecutive losses
Scalping is spread-sensitive; lack of built-in spread filter may cause high-cost trades
No new bar check, potentially opening duplicate positions on the same candle
Stop-loss is relatively large compared to take-profit (risk-reward ratio ~2:1), requiring high win rates for profitability
improvements: 增加基于账户余额百分比或ATR的动态仓位计算模块
添加点差过滤和新K线检查以提升交易质量和防止重复开仓
引入最大回撤限制和连续亏损后的自动仓位缩减逻辑
improvements_en: Add dynamic lot calculation module based on account equity percentage or ATR
Implement spread filter and new bar check to improve trade quality and prevent duplicate entries
Introduce maximum drawdown limits and automatic position reduction logic after consecutive losses

risk_points: 剥头皮策略对点差高度敏感，高点差环境可能侵蚀全部利润
未做新K线检查可能导致同一信号重复开仓，造成过度持仓
缺少最大回撤保护，极端行情下面临大幅亏损风险
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy is highly sensitive to spread; high-spread environments can erode all profits
No new bar check may cause duplicate positions on the same signal, leading to overexposure
Lack of maximum drawdown protection exposes the account to significant losses in extreme markets

It aims to capture small price movements with tight take-profit targets and employs a trailing stop mechanism to lock in gains. The EA is designed for liquid currency pairs and operates primarily on M1-M15 charts.
